race.comment: PREVENTION (9) was reported to have not coped with racing over 1600m last start at Caulfield-Heath, which is of some concern over the same trip here, but she does drop way down in class, which should help. If she can get handy without spending too much energy from a wide gate, then she is worth another chance. RICH KING (3) is a lightly tried 5YO gelding who broke through for an easy maiden win at Bendigo just over 5 weeks ago. Can feature. OCTANE REIGN (1) improved a little finishing midfield last start at Geelong when very long odds, capable of a show. GYMKHANA (7) made it three unplaced runs from three starts this time in work when sixth over 1600m at Kilmore two weeks ago. Can contest for a place.
